content.text: On Sunday The Bachelorette: Before the First Rose Special gives a sneak peek at the upcoming season of the hit dating competition. Before the 2026 Bachelorette gives out the first rose, the world gets a preview of new season with The Bachelorette: Before the First Rose. This season, Taylor Frankie Paul, a content creator who also appeared on The Secret Lifes of Mormon Wives, now serves as the 24th bachelorette. Paul has been a main cast member of The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives since season one and is one of seven characters that have been on the series for each season. She is a 31-year-old single mother from Herriman, Utah. The 22 contestants and hopefuls will try to win her heart and earn a rose every week. Over the years Merrill has earned one gold medal and two bronze medals between the 2019 Parapan Games in Lima, 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo and the 2024 World Championships in Kobe.
